name: Orion Minerals Limited
source: Orion Minerals Limited Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 30 June 2025 (A$ thousands read as ABSOLUTE AUD). Values are the audited group figures before non-controlling interests so that Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit.
source_note: The prior file held three Yahoo Finance periods whose rows did not reconcile (operating result minus net finance costs did not reach the stated loss before tax) and whose earnings per share contradicted the audited figure, so the two years the annual report prints are kept. The audited statement reports basic loss per share in cents: 0.18 cents for FY2025 and 0.09 cents for FY2024. The earnings per share row carries cents, which is the unit the audited statement uses (0.18 cents for FY2025 and 0.09 cents for FY2024).
